artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a prominent building resembling a church on the right side. The perspective is elevated, offering a view of the building and its surroundings. The horizon is low, showcasing the structure against a sky filled with clouds. The clouds are depicted with fine linework, and the technique involves detailed cross-hatching for depth and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of brown ink. People are seen near the building, with some engaging in conversation and others tending to livestock. Trees and a fence are present, adding to the pastoral setting. In the lower right corner, there is a dedication inscription in elegant cursive on a stone-like structure.

artworks.title: A Choral Band
artworks.description: The image shows a group of caricatured individuals seated closely together, primarily focusing on their upper bodies and faces. They appear to be sitting in two rows, with the first row slightly lower than the one behind it. Most of the figures have exaggerated facial features, such as prominent noses and large eyes, with varied expressions ranging from concentrated to mischievous. Their hairstyles are varied, with some having long, curly hair and others sporting wigs typical of the 18th century. The people are dressed in formal attire, resembling 18th-century fashion, complete with jackets that have high collars and large buttons. One figure in the lower left is wearing a distinctive hat adorned with a decoration like a plume. Another figure holds a quill in one hand over a large book or document labeled on the desk. The environment suggests a formal meeting chamber or courtroom, with decorative elements such as ornate wood carving and panelling. In the background are more faces outlined in the audience, watching the scene, with some light architectural detailing visible as well.

artworks.title: A Fellow of Maudlin
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people from the waist up. The individuals have exaggerated facial features, cartoonish appearances, and eccentric hairstyles. They are engaging in different actions or expressions, with varied poses. The central figure holds a staff with detailed carvings, under a large decorative object, possibly a framed portrait. The people wear clothing with older fashion styles, like ruffled collars and layered garments. Some hold objects like a book, while others gesture animatedly. In the background, there are rough lines indicating a sketched backdrop.

artworks.title: Two Fleeing Figures (Atlanta and Hippomenes?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a semi-nude figure carrying a basket on their back, with a cloaked figure walking alongside, set in a countryside landscape. The drawing depicts a forested landscape with a stream or river flowing beside the characters. In the background, there is a structure resembling a temple or ancient building partially covered by foliage. The figures in the foreground are positioned dynamically, with the semi-nude figure appearing to carry something heavy while the cloaked figure offers support or companionship. The line work is intricate, providing texture to the environment and clothing.

artworks.title: Coast Scene
artworks.description: The image is a detailed line drawing depicting a coastal scene. The horizon line is relatively low in the composition, emphasizing the sky filled with clouds. On the left is a rocky ledge with a leafless tree, while on the right, a sailboat is tethered to a cliff edge. In the distance, smaller boats are approaching the shoreline. The artist used fine, deliberate brushstrokes to create a textured appearance, with a monochromatic scheme of warm sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in full body. One figure is holding a child. The person looks serene and is wearing a long garment with a hood. The child has a gentle expression and is partly wrapped in cloth. The person has a circular design around the head, and the background has radiating lines creating a pattern. The attire has intricate patterns and textures. There is an inscription in the lower-left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image shows a series of ornate vases with intricate detailing and decorative embellishments like floral motifs and human figures. The vases are drawn in black ink on a light-toned paper background. There are five objects aligned horizontally from left to right, with each vase differing slightly in height and detail. The central vase is the most prominent, featuring elaborate floral arrangements and figures.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of six ornately designed vases and urns. The objects display intricate detailing, which includes depictions of human figures and decorative elements. One vase has a skull fixture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. From left to right, there is a vase with serpent-shaped handles, a larger urn with human figure reliefs and a tall, domed lid, a medium-sized covered vase, a tall, intricate urn with foliage and a central skull with a garland, a narrower urn with flowing designs, and a smaller vase with a sculpted laughing face on the far right.

artworks.title: Landscape with Windmill
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is positioned low, with trees and hills fading into the sky. Two figures are seated on the ground, with a windmill to the right and birds in flight. The artwork is detailed with fine lines, capturing textures, and uses a monochromatic palette of sepia and black. Small figures are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Lustful: Paolo and Francesca
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various intertwined figures in a swirling mass. The composition includes a central spiral of figures and movement lines, surrounded by a textured landscape. One side shows a cloaked figure near a person on the ground, with a bright circular shape above them containing two more figures. The drawing showcases fine line work and detailed attention to the flow of the composition.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; the Devils Tormenting Ciampolo
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in a dramatic scene. One figure appears to be pulling or reaching toward another, who seems to be recoiling or retreating. The figure on the left is pulling away, while the central figure on the right is extending a hand towards them. Behind the central figure, there are more figures intertwined. The background features swirling lines suggesting a stormy environment, with clouds and waves. Angular shapes and muscular forms enhance the intensity and drama, complemented by detailed etching work on the figures and landscape.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; the Devils Mauling Each Other
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two winged figures flying over swirling waters. The image portrays two muscular, winged figures in a dynamic pose as they soar above stylized, swirling water. The figures appear to be in motion with expressive gestures. In the background, there is a mountainous landscape depicted in a sketchy, minimalistic style with faint lines and shading. Behind the main figures, there are also several sketch-like outlines of figures standing on the rocky terrain.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Agnolo Brunelleschi Attacked by a Six-Footed Serpent
artworks.description: The image depicts five figures in various poses. Two figures are on the left, observing the scene. The central figure is a creature with human-like features and a muscular body. Two other figures on the right appear startled. The background shows a landscape with hills, abstract patterns, and mythological creatures. An inscription is at the bottom right corner. The scene is monochromatic with detailed textures.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Buoso Donati Attacked by the Serpent
artworks.description: The image shows four figures standing within an abstract environment. The first figure on the left is holding their hands up and wearing a robe. The second figure behind the first wears similar attire. The third and fourth figures, nude males with muscular bodies, appear to be reacting to something in the scene. The setting includes stylized clouds and a landscape with flame-like or pointed formations. A serpentine creature emerges between the third and fourth figures. The background is highly stylized with swirling patterns and jagged lines.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Falsifiers: Dante and Virgil Covering their Noses because of the stench
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring tortured figures and mountainous landscapes. The foreground shows figures in distress or anguish, engaged in struggle. Two tall, robed figures stand on a rocky outcrop overseeing the scene below. The background shows ominous clouds and distant mountains, creating a sense of despair. The composition is detailed and conveys intense emotions related to suffering and conflict.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Traitors; Dante's Foot Striking Bocca degli Abbate
artworks.description: A drawing of two robed figures standing near a body of water with faces visible beneath the surface. The scene is in a monochromatic style, with the central figures draped in flowing garments by the water, filled with faces of individuals. Some faces are partially submerged, showing expressions of distress or contemplation. The foreground displays detailed faces, creating a mood and narrative. In the background, a rocky cliff with carved faces adds to the mystical atmosphere. The composition blends human forms with natural elements, creating a surreal quality. The drawing's style suggests a symbolic or allegorical theme, focusing on the interaction between the figures and their environment in this ethereal landscape.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Lustful: Paolo and Francesca
artworks.description: This is a drawing of swirling figures and celestial imagery, featuring a large spiral composed of intertwined figures, a cloaked figure next to a reclining form, and another form encircled by light above. The composition is filled with intricate detailing, creating a sense of motion and interaction. The style is reminiscent of works inspired by the Romantic period.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Lustful: Paolo and Francesca
artworks.description: This is a drawing of swirling figures. The scene depicts a spiral of figures flowing together. There is a sense of motion and interaction among them. On one side, a robed figure gazes upon a reclining figure on the ground. The composition is detailed, with flowing lines creating movement and energy. Shading and line work create depth and texture in this monochromatic work.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Swordsman Standing Over His Defeated Opponent [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and potential structures sketched with light pencil lines. The composition includes several indistinct human forms positioned amid architectural elements, suggested by faint lines resembling structures or columns. The figures are roughly outlined and carry a sense of movement, especially the central figure in stride. The overall impression is of an unfinished study or preparatory sketch, with each line delicate and suggestive rather than definitive.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Swordsman Standing Over His Defeated Opponent [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows several abstract figures in long flowing garments. The figures are loosely defined and appear to be standing or possibly interacting in a group. The elongated forms are outlined in thin, soft pencil strokes, giving the piece an ethereal and unfinished quality. The clothing forms graceful lines that suggest movement. The use of shading is minimal, emphasizing the shapes' contour and form rather than details.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Hans Bol
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing a bustling scene. In the distance, there are hills, a waterway with small boats, and a large fortified building surrounded by activity. The detailed engraving features fine and meticulous lines, depicting textures and patterns. The monochromatic color palette focuses on brown tones against the paper, creating depth. The scene includes architectural details, figures, and winter activities, with trees in the sky.

artworks.title: Croix de Moulin-les-Planches
artworks.description: The image shows a stone cross in the foreground, surrounded by buildings and trees. People are gathered around the base of the cross. The buildings are rustic with stone and wooden elements, with smoke rising from one structure. The artwork features fine brushstrokes, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is monochromatic, using grayscale shades. Trees and distant structures can be seen in the background, with a lightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Charles Lameth
artworks.medium: etching, stipple and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features the upper body of a man in profile, facing right. The man has a sharp nose and prominent cheekbones, with composed expression. His hair is styled traditionally in the 18th century, powdered and tied back. He wears a formal coat with buttons, a high-collared shirt, and a cravat. There is no visible jewelry or objects in hand. The background is a textured oval set against a blank space. The text below identifies him as Charles Lameth, a deputy to the National Assembly in 1789, with publisher information at the bottom.

artworks.title: Pheasant and Cattail (Faisan et roseau)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird with long tail feathers and a cattail plant. The drawing is created with intricate, fine lines, capturing the delicate form of the bird which seems to be in motion, its tail elegantly trailing behind it. The bird's plumage is detailed with various patterns, and its neck appears to be gracefully arched. Below the bird, a faint outline of a cattail plant is visible, with its slender stalk and elongated leaves rendered with minimalistic strokes. The background is plain, allowing the focus to remain on the bird and plant. A small red seal is present near the bottom of the drawing.
